```{r}

#rm(list = ls())
library(energy)
set.seed(23)

# Exercise 3. Autocovariance and autocorrelation of an AR(1) process:

n <- 500
sigma <- 2
epsilone <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma) # we generated 500 random errors

Y <- numeric(500)
Y[1] <- epsilone[1]

for (t in 2:n) {
  Y[t] <- 0.7* Y[t-1] + epsilone[t]
  
}

Y

Y_bar <- mean(Y)

# Autocovariance γ_hat(h):


gamma_hat <- function(Y,h) {
  sum((Y[1:(n-h)] - Y_bar) * (Y[(1+h):n] - Y_bar)) / n
}

gam <- sapply(0:(n-1), function(h) gamma_hat(Y, h))

head(gam)

# Autocorrelation ρ_(h) for lags h = 0,1,...n−1:

rho <- gam / gam[1] 
head(rho)

rho_acf <- acf(Y, lag.max = n-1)$acf[, 1, 1]

all.equal(rho, rho_acf)

# Distance autocorrelation (therom 7 formula):

h <- 3
dcor(Y[1:(n-h)], Y[(1+h):n]) # distance autocorrelation for lag h=3

# dcor() returns R(X,Y) directly (not squared), between 0 and 1.

dcor_hat <- function(Y, h) {
  if (h == 0) return(1)              # R(Y_t, Y_t) = 1 by definition
  dcor(Y[1:(n-h)], Y[(1+h):n])
}

dcor_vals <- sapply(0:20, function(h) dcor_hat(Y, h))
head(dcor_vals)

```
